pages.text: $(#1E90FF)🌊 Wrath of the Ocean · Abyssal Awakening 🐚$()$(br2)$(l)$(#00CED1)「Those who drink this tidal essence shall become one with the tsunami」$()$(br)When the poison of $(#FFD700)Swollen Pufferfish$() is neutralized by $(#4682B4)Prismarine Resonance$(), the defense of $(#228B22)Dragon Scale Armor$() and the flexibility of $(#00BFFF)Abyssal Kelp$() achieve balance in the $(#000080)Tidal Mortar$()—this becomes a forbidden elixir capable of $(l)granting land-dwellers temporary dominion over the sea$().

$(#00BFFF)▌ Trident of the Sea God $()$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🐬 Riptide Tailfin$()$(br)Leaves behind $(#7FFFD4)glowing turbulence$() when swimming, doubling speed.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)⚡ Deep-Sea Pickaxe$()$(br)Attacks unleash $(#CD5C5C)high-pressure water blades$().$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🌀 Perpetual Air Bubble$()$(br)Generates $(#00CED1)rotating oxygen rings$() overhead automatically.

$(br2)$(#228B22)▌ Abyssal Brewing $()$(br)- Mix $(#FFD700)Pufferfish Venom Glands$() with $(#4682B4)Prismarine Powder$() in $(#000080)Seawater$() until it turns $(#00BFFF)electric blue$().$(br)- $(#228B22)Dragon Scales$() must be soaked in $(#00CED1)Moonlit Tides$() for $(#1E90FF)three days and nights$().$(br)- When adding $(#00BFFF)Kelp$(), stir in a $(#7FFFD4)spiral-nine-turn$() motion.$(br2)$(#9370DB)※$() The brew is perfected when $(#00BFFF)layered wave patterns$() appear, revealing $(#FFD700)phantom fish schools$().

$(br2)$(#000080)『 Lost Sea Chart Records 』$()$(br)A seawater-damaged navigator's log:$(br)'Upon consuming this $(#00BFFF)Liquid Storm Eye$(),$(br)one shall gain:$(br)- The $(#32CD32)speed of a Sailfish$().$(br)- The $(#FF4500)digging power of a Deep-Sea Worm$().$(br)- The $(#4169E1)underwater adaptability of an Octopus$().$(br)But they must return to $(#9370DB)land before the tides retreat$(),$(br)lest the $(#000080)ocean$() forever mark them as $(#228B22)traitors$().'
